info.name: MyInvois Middleware Gateway
info.description:
Complete API collection for MyInvois Middleware Gateway with all 9 document types.

## Document Types
- 01: Invoice
- 02: Credit Note
- 03: Debit Note
- 04: Refund Note
- 11: Self-billed Invoice
- 12: Self-billed Credit Note
- 13: Self-billed Debit Note
- 14: Self-billed Refund Note
- Consolidated Invoice (multiple lines)

item.name: Document Submissions
item.description: All 9 document type submission examples with complete UBL 2.1 JSON schemas.

request.description:
**Invoice (Type 01)** - Standard e-invoice for goods/services.

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 01
- Uses InvoicedQuantity for line items
- Tax Code 01 = Sales Tax (6%)

request.description:
**Credit Note (Type 02)** - Return/cancellation/adjustment (credit to customer).

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 02
- BillingReference: References original invoice
- Used for partial refunds, returns, price adjustments

request.description:
**Debit Note (Type 03)** - Additional charges/adjustments (charge to customer).

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 03
- BillingReference: References original invoice
- Used for additional charges, price increases, late fees

request.description:
**Refund Note (Type 04)** - Full refund issued to customer.

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 04
- PaymentMeansCode: 03 (Bank Transfer)
- BillingReference: References original invoice
- Used for full refunds, order cancellations

request.description:
**Self-billed Invoice (Type 11)** - Invoice issued BY buyer ON BEHALF of seller.

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 11
- **ROLE REVERSAL**: Supplier = Vendor (not authenticated), Customer = Buyer (authenticated with TIN)
- Used in B2B self-billing arrangements (e.g., agricultural purchases)

exec: if (pm.response.code === 202) { var r = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('trackingId', r.trackingId); if (r.acceptedDocuments && r.acceptedDocuments.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('documentUuid', r.acceptedDocuments[0].uuid); }}

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 12
- BillingReference: References original self-billed invoice
- **ROLE REVERSAL**: Same as Type 11
- Used for returns/adjustments in self-billing arrangements

request.description:
**Consolidated Invoice (Type 01 with multiple lines)** - Monthly/periodic invoice combining multiple transactions.

**Key Fields:**
- InvoiceTypeCode: 01 (standard invoice)
- InvoicePeriod: Date range covered
- Multiple InvoiceLine items with different classifications
- Used for monthly billing, consolidated transactions

**This example includes:**
- 5 line items with different products/services
- Mixed classification codes (003, 004, 022)
- Tax calculated per line and totaled
- Total: MYR 1,325.00 (including 6% tax)
